_status: FROZEN 21 Oct 2026 before any main search run. Changes after this date go to deviations[] with date and reason.

confirmatory_test.status: downloaded 21 Oct 2026, validated, hashed; no model evaluated on it
confirmatory_test.rule: processed and hashed before any model is evaluated on it; loaded only by scripts/paper3/confirmatory_test.py after the selection rule and selected configurations are committed and tagged
confirmatory_test.convention_check: MKM 180 vs LM 180 (training case): median differences 0.2-4 % of range, max 17 % (Pi12); no sign or unit error

not_searched.epochs: early stopping on inner validation, patience 200, max 5000

objectives.f_err: mean over inner leave-one-Re_tau-out folds of E_Pi on the held-out inner case
objectives.f_gen: max over the five inner folds of E_Pi(fold) / E_Pi_M0(fold), E_Pi_M0 = mean over seeds 0-4 (decided 20 Oct 2026). Largest on folds where M0 is most accurate (Re_tau 1000, 2000: about 0.02)
objectives.f_phys_A: 0.5 * rti / max(rti_M0, 1e-4) + 0.5 * coef_norm / coef_norm_M0 (rti_M0 = 0.00599, coef_norm_M0 = 3.578; floor 1e-4 approved 21 Oct 2026)
objectives.f_cost: matrix-multiply FLOPs per point, torch.utils.flop_counter.FlopCounterMode, float64, one point
objectives.aggregation: mean over seeds; seed SD stored
objectives.noise_level_for_ties: seed SD of M0 f_err over seeds 0-4 (0.0073), because one seed per candidate gives no per-candidate SD

qnehvi.implementation: src/ps3/qnehvi.py (deviation 1): qLogNEHVI, exact 4-objective box decomposition, 5 restarts, 256 raw samples, maxiter 100
qnehvi.batch: sequential, q = 1 (changed from q = 4: one trial at a time keeps all strategies on the same evaluation schedule)
qnehvi.reference_point: BoTorch/Optuna default inferred from observed data (approved 21 Oct 2026)

selection_rule.feasibility: f_phys <= M0 value (Arm A: 1.0 by construction) and f_cost <= 2 x M0 (206556 FLOPs); Arm B also trace_rel_mean <= 1e-3 and rot_excess <= 0.01 (approved 21 Oct 2026)
selection_rule.choice: lowest f_gen among feasible; ties within the M0 seed SD (0.0073 on f_err) -> lower f_cost
selection_rule.refit: all five LM cases, epochs = median inner best epoch, seeds 0-9

statistics.bootstrap: Paper 2 paired hierarchical bootstrap, 4000 replicates, resampling optimizer seeds, refit seeds and 10% moving blocks
statistics.consistent: resolved, larger than the optimizer-seed range of both strategies, same sign on both confirmatory cases

compute.platform: Linux x86-64, 2 cores, Python 3.13.16, one thread per job
compute.seconds_per_evaluation: pilot: 97 s mean with 2 seeds (9.7 s per fit); about 49 s with 1 seed
compute.optimizer_overhead: qNEHVI about 22 s per proposal at 26 trials (synthetic test); grows with trials; measured and reported separately (RQ4)

reference_M0.reproduction: seed 0 inner f_err 0.05648547099762058 equals Paper 2 inner_val_E_Pi exactly
reference_M0.note: Paper 2 TPE tuned with seed 0 only; seed 0 is the best of seeds 0-4 (winner's-curse evidence)

scope_items: no geometry or flow-regime transfer (proposal Cases C, D)
CFD-level objectives J_U and J_R only (no J_P, J_sep)

in: Reynolds-number transfer in plane channel flow (Lee & Moser inner folds; Hoyas & Jimenez comparability; Moser-Kim-Mansour confirmatory)
a priori multi-objective selection (Arms A and B)
a posteriori 1D RSM channel solve of selected models (Stage 2); solver-in-the-loop NSGA-II (Stage 3) with J_U, J_R

later_stages: ablations A2 (no f_gen), A3 (weighted sum), A4 (no f_phys)

execution.storage: one Optuna SQLite study per job (results/paper3/search/<job>/study.db)
execution.sessions: background runs are limited to 2 h; a worker stops starting new trials after 100 min and the job resumes from its study in the next session
execution.interrupted_trials: a trial left RUNNING by a killed session is marked FAIL with user attr interrupted=true, excluded from the 200-evaluation budget and from analysis, and listed in the job log
execution.resume_seed: sampler seed on a resumed session = optimizer_seed * 1000 + number of trials already in the study (deterministic given the resume points; recorded in sessions.jsonl)
execution.failed_fits: non-finite training -> trial FAIL, counted in the budget, infeasible
execution.threads: one torch thread per job; two jobs in parallel on 2 cores

deviations.what: qNEHVI acquisition-optimisation budget reduced: num_restarts 20->5, raw_samples 1024->256, maxiter 200->100 (src/ps3/qnehvi.py); everything else as optuna_integration 5.0.0 qnehvi_candidates_func
deviations.why: optimizer overhead per proposal grew from 57 s (trials 21-30) to 219 s (trials 61-70) and was projected to about 20 min by trial 200, adding about a week of compute for 10 jobs
deviations.evidence: on the same 69 trials one proposal took 327 s with the frozen settings and 87 s with the new ones (3.8x; both under CPU contention)
deviations.effect: applies to all 10 qNEHVI jobs; the job started under the frozen settings (qnehvi__armA__seed3001, 69 trials) is rerun from scratch and kept in results/paper3/search_superseded/ as RQ4 overhead evidence only. Other strategies unaffected.
deviations.naming: the acquisition is BoTorch's qLogNoisyExpectedHypervolumeImprovement (qLogNEHVI, Ament et al. 2023), the log-scaled form of qNEHVI; this was already the case under the frozen settings via optuna_integration and is now stated explicitly
